intended_use: Deterministic, research-use-only conformance checking of declared preanalytic metadata for human brain tissue bottom-up mass-spectrometry proteomics.

assay_versions.1.0.0: Label-free bottom-up DDA or DIA using the enumerated instruments, cleavage agents, dissociation methods, and raw-data representations.

specimen_versions.1.0.0: Human brain solid tissue preserved frozen or by neutral-buffered-formalin fixation and paraffin embedding.

field_groups.purpose: Bind the exact analytical sample to an opaque source-specimen lineage without embedding personal or clinical identity.
Preserve treatment, genomic, transcriptomic, and PTM context as immutable upstream pointers rather than copied claims or fused data.
Capture specimen origin, preservation, ischemia, stabilization, storage, and fixation with explicit units and conditionality.
Capture the approved protocol, input mass, extraction, reduction, alkylation, proteolysis, and fractionation needed to interpret a proteomics assay.
Bind one analytical run to an explicit strategy, label, instrument, dissociation method, raw artifact, replicate, LC conditions, and fraction.
Retain the referenced quality review and quantitative tissue/protein observations without converting a declared value into a scientific quality claim.

controlled_vocabulary_catalog.authority: profile subset with NCBI Taxonomy accession

unit_catalog.bounds_policy: Every numeric bound is expressed in the field's explicit reference_unit after deterministic affine conversion.

privacy_and_identity_policy.allowed: Opaque, non-identifying identifiers and content digests.
privacy_and_identity_policy.linkage: Personal and clinical identity remain in separately governed upstream objects; the execution-context identity decision supplies the binding authority while this profile stores only opaque node identifiers and provenance digests.

feature_policy.missingness: The engine may score a view only when observed features meet minimum_view_coverage; unresolved values are never imputed.

integrated_guard.algorithm: deterministic per-view nearest medoid with Gower distance and consensus abstention
integrated_guard.candidate_input: A mapping from declared feature paths to already validated scalar values converted to protocol reference units.
integrated_guard.result: An aggregate in-domain, out-of-domain, indeterminate, unavailable, or not-applicable status with consensus, mean distance, evaluated-view count, versioned artifact digests, and a bounded reason code; cluster labels, neighbors, feature values, and per-view votes remain internal.
integrated_guard.decision_authority: The guard runs only after deterministic metadata conformance. It may preserve conformance or downgrade it to quarantine with human review; it can never promote, cure, or override a nonconformant, quarantined, or review-required result.
integrated_guard.claim_ceiling: Reference-domain proximity to a synthetic corpus is not a trained or calibrated model result, biological-quality claim, assay-fitness claim, diagnosis, prognosis, or clinical recommendation.

agent_extension_rules: A new accepted term requires a versioned vocabulary change, source review, conformance fixture, and explicit support-domain decision.
A new optional field must be listed in conditional_fields with executable compatibility rules; undocumented optionality is prohibited.
A new unit must be supported by the pinned UCUM implementation and must declare a reference unit before profile adoption.
External references remain immutable pointers; agents must not copy, relabel, fuse, or infer their scientific content in M01-01.
Clinical use, personal data, direct treatment claims, and kinase-state ownership require a different authorized module boundary.
